description: Worked examples printed in Albane, Slimani & Kheddouci (2025), Figures 3–5. Algerian (Kabyle) conventions: Rule R1 turns full vowels after a single consonant into (unprinted) diacritics, ⴳ is ڨ, ⵝ is ث, initial a is أ.
sourceType: published paper; different (Algerian) convention — used only to document convention differences, never as gold for Moroccan output

entries.note: Text says kasra on ف and sukun on ل; the printed figure shows no diacritics.
Text says ⴱⴱ → ب with shadda; the printed figure shows no shadda.
